integrity: The covariance identities and short-time boundary argument are analytic. The bundled exact-arithmetic checker verifies only the finite algebraic identities and positivity condition; it is not used as a substitute for the stochastic proof. The earliest public date is the arXiv v1 date.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the displayed independent-noise SIR system and finite axis-aligned rectangles. It does not invalidate the Fokker--Planck optimal-control theory when the bounded zero-flux PDE is interpreted as a separate confined model, and it does not classify reflected or correlated-noise variants.
title: Independent compartment noise breaks transmission-noise equivalence on bounded SIR domains
